candidate_workaround: Expose the exact failed child selection output before changing any test or validator.
failure_signature: A checked subprocess exception hides captured stdout and stderr from the lifecycle validator.
recurrence_guard: Lifecycle validators must surface captured child diagnostics or direct operators to one exact isolated selection before recovery.
rollback: Retain the aggregate failure with zero pass credit and change no test until its exact output is visible.
scope_boundary: Diagnostic visibility only; the isolated command may still fail and earns no test-pass or canonical-final credit.
title: Expose exact child diagnostics before recovery
trigger_preconditions: A scoped validation wrapper stops on a captured child failure without printing the child result.
